title: StatelessCalculationEnvelope
description: Wire contract for the JSON body returned by the tax-calc-engine's POST /api/calculate. C46-COMPAT: authored to back the compatibility-registry `engineImplementation.resultSchemaHash` field (repos/rule-packs/annual/uk-sa/2025-26/1.0.0/compatibility-manifests.json, schema repos/rule-packs/src/annual-definitions.ts:75-106). Envelope level (result/warnings/specials/exclusions/engineVersion/rulesetVersion/inputHash) cross-verified 2026-08-08 between firstlot-suite src/lib/filing/calculation.ts (`StatelessCalculationEnvelope`, `isEnvelope`) and tax-calc-engine FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Controllers/StatelessCalculationController.cs `Calculate` — matched, no divergence found. The inner `result` object is sourced from FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Core/Serialization/EnvelopeResultJson.cs (`ToEnvelopeShape`), the sole producer of that object; the Suite itself treats `result` as opaque (`Record<string, unknown>`) beyond reading `result.totalIncomeTax`, which it accepts as a 2dp decimal string or number (calculation.ts `engineMoney`) and which the engine always emits as a 2dp decimal string (EnvelopeResultJson `Money`) — confirmed consistent, including against the literal '3486.00' fixture in firstlot-suite src/__tests__/filing/d046-e2e-contract.test.ts:100. Not yet referenced by the compatibility registry; that edit and ratification are a separate, later step.

warnings.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained — no committed contract exists for a populated warning yet.

specials.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained.

exclusions.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained.

engineVersion.description: Engine assembly informational version, e.g. '0.9.0' or '0.9.0+<git-sha>'. The Suite pins to exactly APPROVED_TAX_ENGINE_VERSION or that value plus a '+<build-metadata>' suffix (calculation.ts approvedEngineVersion); no separate wire-level format is enforced by the engine itself.

moneyString.description: GBP amount rendered as a fixed 2dp decimal string (C# `decimal.ToString("F2")` in EnvelopeResultJson.Money) rather than a raw JSON number, so no consumer has to trust float round-tripping over the wire.

bucketSlice.description: One per-rate-bucket slice of a band allocation. Mirrors C# BucketSlice (FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Core/Models/IncomeTaxResult.cs).

bucket.description: Closed vocabulary observed in FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Calculators/Income/IncomeTaxCalculator.cs (Bucket(...) call sites): 'basic'/'higher'/'additional' appear in all three categories; 'starter'/'psa' appear only under `bands.savings`; 'allowance' appears only under `bands.dividends`. This schema does not further restrict which subset applies to which array.

rate.description: Statutory rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.20). Not money — stays a JSON number (EnvelopeResultJson doc comment).

rateJurisdiction.description: 'scottish' never appears here — it is a typed refusal (422 JURISDICTION_UNSUPPORTED) before any result is produced, per IncomeTaxResult.cs doc comment.
